## Setup
```{r}
#| include: false

options(conflicts.policy = "depends.ok")
library(tidyverse) 
library(lubridate)
library(skimr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

devtools::source_url("https://github.com/jjcurtin/lab_support/blob/main/format_path.R?raw=true")

theme_set(theme_classic())
options(dplyr.print_max=Inf)

path_shared <- format_path("risk2/data_processed/shared")
```

## Load in data

```{r}
recovery_dates <- read_csv(here::here(path_shared, "recovery_dates.csv"), 
                show_col_types = FALSE) |> 
  select(-ResponseID) |>
  rename(moud_date = onboard_si_mat_2)

study_dates <- read_csv(here::here(path_shared, "study_dates_gps.csv"), 
                show_col_types = FALSE) |> 
  select(subid, study_start) |> 
  left_join(recovery_dates, by = "subid")

sample_char <- read_csv(here::here(path_shared, "survey_intake.csv"), 
                show_col_types = FALSE) |> 
  select(subid, med) |> 
  left_join(study_dates, by = "subid") |> 
  mutate(med = case_when(
  str_detect(med, "daily") ~ "daily",
  str_detect(med, "monthly") ~ "monthly",
  str_detect(med, "not taking") ~ "none"
)) |> 
  mutate(days_recover = as.numeric(study_start - moud_date))

gps_context <- read_csv(here::here(path_shared, "gps_context.csv"), 
                show_col_types = FALSE) |> 
  mutate(context_id = 1:n(),
         help = factor(help,
                       levels = c("Extremely", "Considerably", "Moderately", "Mildly", "Not at all"),
                       ordered = TRUE),
         harm = factor(harm,
                       levels = c("Extremely", "Considerably", "Moderately", "Mildly", "Not at all"),
                       ordered = TRUE),
         pleasant = factor(pleasant,
                       levels = c("Always", "Most of the time", "Sometimes", "Rarely", "Never"),
                       ordered = TRUE),
         unpleasant = factor(unpleasant,
                       levels = c("Always", "Most of the time", "Sometimes", "Rarely", "Never"),
                       ordered = TRUE))
  
# ples unples
  # "Always", "Most of the time", "Sometimes", "Rarely", "Never"
  
# help harm
  # "Extremely", "Considerably", "Moderately", "Mildly", "Not at all"
```

## Characteristics of the sample

What meds?
```{r}
janitor::tabyl(sample_char$med)
```

Length of time in recovery
```{r}
skim((sample_char$days_recover))

sample_char |> 
  mutate(greater_3mo = if_else(days_recover >= 90, "yes", "no")) |> 
  janitor::tabyl(greater_3mo)
```

## Correlation

```{r}
cor(as.numeric(gps_context$help), as.numeric(gps_context$harm), method = "spearman", use = "complete.obs")
```

```{r}
cor(as.numeric(gps_context$pleasant), as.numeric(gps_context$unpleasant), method = "spearman", use = "complete.obs")
```

```{r}
gps_context |> 
  drop_na() |> 
  ggplot(aes(help, harm)) +
  geom_count() +
  scale_size_area()
```

```{r}
gps_context |> 
  drop_na() |> 
  ggplot(aes(pleasant, unpleasant)) +
  geom_count() +
  scale_size_area()
```


```{r}
# percentage of observations for each pleasant x unpleasant combination
# (rows missing pleasant or unpleasant are excluded)
gps_context |>
  drop_na(pleasant, unpleasant) |>
  count(pleasant, unpleasant) |>
  mutate(pct = round(n / sum(n) * 100, 1)) |>
  arrange(desc(pct))

# same percentages as a pleasant (rows) x unpleasant (columns) table
gps_context |>
  drop_na(pleasant, unpleasant) |>
  count(pleasant, unpleasant) |>
  mutate(pct = round(n / sum(n) * 100, 1)) |>
  select(-n) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = unpleasant, values_from = pct, values_fill = 0)
```

```{r}
# percentage of observations for each help x harm combination
# (rows missing help or harm are excluded)
gps_context |>
  drop_na(help, harm) |>
  count(help, harm) |>
  mutate(pct = round(n / sum(n) * 100, 1)) |>
  arrange(desc(pct))

# same percentages as a help (rows) x harm (columns) table
gps_context |>
  drop_na(help, harm) |>
  count(help, harm) |>
  mutate(pct = round(n / sum(n) * 100, 1)) |>
  select(-n) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = harm, values_from = pct, values_fill = 0)
```
